ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Woodhill Capital Ponzi Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged Ponzi scheme by Woodhill Capital and follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the fraud.
questions: How much money was invested in Woodhill Capital?
Who were the main beneficiaries of the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale financial fraud and bring those responsible to justice. I will use financial records and interviews with investors to uncover the truth.
